name: Brackwell Pumpkin Patch
summary: Defias brigands have taken over Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in southeastern Elwynn Forest. The farm once belonged to the Brackwell family, but now its cottage and fields serve as a hideout where conspirators meet and stolen mine gold is received.

sections.title: A Bandit Haven
sections.body: You find the Brackwell farm southeast of the Stonefield homestead, its fields no longer tended. The Brackwell family has vanished, driven away or worse as crime spread through the area. The Defias Brotherhood now occupies the sturdy cottage and overgrown fields. Brigands regroup here beyond the reach of Goldshire's patrols. Morgan the Collector and other prominent conspirators use the isolated farm to receive illicit gold taken from the forest's mines.

sections.title: Pigs and Dark Magic
sections.body: The Defias share the pumpkin vines with a giant sow named Princess, left behind by the Brackwells. She roams the patch and terrorizes neighboring fields. The farmhouse attic and outbuildings shelter other dangerous dealings. Bandit Erlan Drudgemoor seduced Surena Caledon, a rogue warlock apprentice who fled her master in Stormwind with a stolen bloodstone artifact. Her presence has drawn dark practitioners to the hideout.

faq.q: What happened to the Brackwell family?
faq.answer: No one knows the Brackwell family's exact fate. When the Defias Brotherhood spread across southeastern Elwynn Forest, the family either fled or was killed, leaving its pumpkin fields and farmhouse to the bandits.

faq.q: Why is the Defias Brotherhood using this farm?
aliases: what are bandits doing at the pumpkin patch
faq.answer: The farm gives the Defias an isolated base near the forest's borders. They store plundered goods and arrange smuggling there, including shipments of stolen mine gold brought by couriers such as Morgan the Collector, away from the Stormwind Guard.

aliases: why is there a huge boar here
faq.answer: Princess is an enormous, prize-winning sow raised by the Brackwells. Left behind when the farm fell, she grew larger by repeatedly breaking into nearby Stonefield Farm to eat its prized crops.

faq.q: Why do warlocks come to the pumpkin patch?
faq.answer: Surena Caledon, apprentice to Stormwind warlock trainer Gakin the Darkbinder, stole a powerful bloodstone choker and fled to the farm with her lover, Defias bandit Erlan Drudgemoor. Gakin sends novice warlocks to kill her and recover the relic.

angles.text: Surena Caledon, a fugitive apprentice, hides in the farm's shack. Her stolen bloodstone choker is needed to bind a voidwalker.
The overrun patch is one of the Defias Brotherhood's easternmost bases in Elwynn, threatening nearby farms and trade routes.
